confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Kuala Lumpur price levels; no live booking pages, menus, or July 2026 listings were checked. Restaurant anchors are moderate confidence. Hostel and hotel nightly rates are less certain and assume typical Malaysian taxes and service charges are included. Cocktail and wine are partly derived from the local beer relationship (about 2.1 to 2.4 times the draft beer anchor) because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is regional: Southeast Asian capital-city pricing, well below Singapore and broadly in line with other mid-cost Southeast Asian tourist cities for food, drink and budget lodging. Accommodation is benchmarked to central visitor districts (Bukit Bintang, Chinatown, KLCC).
